query: SELECT o.event_time,r.collector_receive_time FROM observations o JOIN report_receipts r ON r.observation_id=o.id WHERE o.station_icao=? AND o.product_type='METAR' AND julianday(o.event_time)=julianday(?)
before_plan: SEARCH o USING COVERING INDEX continuous_reference_target (station_icao=? AND product_type=?)
after_plan: SEARCH o USING COVERING INDEX continuous_reference_target (station_icao=? AND product_type=?)
SEARCH r USING COVERING INDEX receipt_observation_clock (observation_id=?)
